plain-scene.bsconfig:
{
  "rootDir": "<ROOT>",
  "files": [
    "manifest",
    "source/**/*",
    "components/**/*"
  ],
  "stagingDir": "<ROOT>/.brighttest/headless-scene/build",
  "createPackage": true,
  "outFile": "<ROOT>/.brighttest/headless-scene/pkg.zip",
  "retainStagingDir": true,
  "autoImportComponentScript": true,
  "diagnosticFilters": [
    1107
  ],
  "plugins": [
    "<REPO>/node_modules/@ramonlobo/rooibos-roku/dist/plugin.js"
  ],
  "rooibos": {
    "isRecordingCodeCoverage": false,
    "testsFilePattern": "**/*.spec.bs",
    "catchCrashes": true,
    "failFast": false,
    "tags": [
      "!deviceOnly"
    ]
  }
}
